name: hermes
description: Run NousResearch's Hermes Agent on ORB Cloud, backed by Z.AI's GLM Coding Plan. Hermes natively supports Telegram webhook mode, so the agent sleeps between messages and wakes in <1s on the next inbound — full ORB savings story applies. Telegram is configured post-deploy via the in-sandbox `hermes-setup-tg` wizard.

required_secrets.name: GLM_API_KEY
required_secrets.obtain_at: https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list — sign up for the GLM Coding Plan
required_secrets.purpose: Z.AI / GLM API key. Sent to https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 (GLM Coding Plan endpoint) via ORB's per-computer LLM proxy. ZAI_API_KEY is also accepted as an alias.

optional_inputs.name: DEPLOY_NAME
optional_inputs.purpose: Identifier for this deploy. Used in DELETE /v1/swarms/<id> for teardown.

exposes.purpose: Telegram webhook receiver. setWebhook is registered against this URL by the post-deploy `hermes-setup-tg` wizard.

post_deploy_steps: Run `hermes-setup-tg` (interactive wizard) — walks through @BotFather, validates the token, registers the webhook against the box's subdomain, writes config to /root/.hermes/.env. The supervisor in start.sh picks up the new env within 10s and starts `hermes gateway start`.

siblings.name: hermes-openrouter
siblings.description: Same Hermes agent, OpenRouter as the LLM upstream — pick any of OpenRouter's 200+ models. Useful when you want model variety or aren't on the GLM Coding Plan.
